folders.input_files: All input csv files required for CyberShake simulation on MN5 in Barcelona supercomputing center (BSC)
folders.source: Kinematic rupture sources created by the Graves-Pitarka method for selected magnitude-fault-plane pairs. SRF format documentation: https://strike.scec.org/scecpedia/Standard_Rupture_Format
folders.PSA: Peak pseudo-spectral acceleration (PSA) at 1.0 s, computed from two horizontal seismograms at 81 synthetic seismic stations.
folders.atkinson2023: Peak pseudo-spectral acceleration (PSA) at 1.0 s, computed from two horizontal seismograms at 81 synthetic seismic stations.
